ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio characterized by dominant high-intensity white pixels on the lateral lobes and low-intensity black pixels concentrated in the central peduncle and medial fluke regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black region forms an anchor-like shape with feathered, high-frequency spatial transitions into the white lateral fields. Distal tips show high-contrast black spotting/mottling against white backgrounds.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 40-45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; frequency increases toward the distal tips, with several distinct deep-amplitude valleys (notches) on the right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly symmetrical upward sweep with a convex leading edge trajectory and a slightly concave trailing edge curvature leading to acute tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel groups (barnacle scars) located at the extreme distal tips and along the leading edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct series of dark, roughly parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the white ventral field of the left lobe, with similar vertical scratches visible on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks (parallel linear scars) across both lobes; a prominent irregular notch/chip at the terminus of the right lobe trailing edge.
